nodes.label: Pending Optimizations Backlog
nodes.description: 7 prioritized optimization items, each with 4 acceptance gates (baseline evidence, focused tests, staged rollout, post-change comparison). Items: 1) Benchmark/simplify AlertService queries, 2) Retire Blade by vertical with API-parity tests, 3) Split SensorApiController by responsibility, 4) Decompose SensorMonitorBoard.vue, 5) Evaluate persistent MQTT client in script_datos.py, 6) Retain central models and shared reading ownership, 7) Add measured ingest/query observability. Non-negotiable preservation: route contracts, reconnect/queue/ordering behavior, Sensor/Device/User ownership, error signals.
nodes.rationale: Defines the optimization backlog with strict evidence-based acceptance criteria. Prevents premature optimization by requiring baseline measurement before any change. Critical for understanding what NOT to change without evidence.
